summary: This clinical trial is testing a study drug called AZD1705 in people with dyslipidemia, which means having an abnormal amount of lipids or fats like cholesterol in the blood. The study aims to look at how the body handles the drug and how safe it is for participants. This trial is sponsored by AstraZeneca and is a Phase 1 study involving 98 participants. The current status of the trial is Active, not recruiting.
